+7|# ----------------- Text normalization -----------------

+9|def normalize_text(text):
+10|    text = re.sub(r"(\d+)\s*\.\s+(\d{2})(?!\d)", r"\1.\2", text)
+11|    text = re.sub(r"(\d+),\s*(\d{2})(?!\d)", r"\1.\2", text)
+12|    return text
+13|
+14|
+15|# ----------------- Date parsing -----------------
+16|
+17|MONTHS = {
+18|    "jan": 1, "feb": 2, "mar": 3, "apr": 4, "may": 5, "jun": 6,
+19|    "jul": 7, "aug": 8, "sep": 9, "sept": 9, "oct": 10, "nov": 11, "dec": 12,
+20|}
+21|
+22|
+23|def _norm_year(y):
+24|    if y < 100:
+25|        return 2000 + y if y < 70 else 1900 + y
+26|    return y
+27|
+28|
+29|def _correct_year(y):
+30|    if 2015 <= y <= 2025:
+31|        return y
+32|    s = str(y)
+33|    for i, ch in enumerate(s):
+34|        if ch == "7":
+35|            cand = int(s[:i] + "1" + s[i + 1:])
+36|            if 2015 <= cand <= 2025:
+37|                return cand
+38|        if ch == "8":
+39|            cand = int(s[:i] + "0" + s[i + 1:])
+40|            if 2015 <= cand <= 2025:
+41|                return cand
+42|    return None
+43|
+44|
+45|def _valid_date(y, m, d):
+46|    if not (1 <= m <= 12 and 1 <= d <= 31):
+47|        return False
+48|    if m in (4, 6, 9, 11) and d > 30:
+49|        return False
+50|    if m == 2:
+51|        leap = (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 != 0) or (y % 400 == 0)
+52|        if d > (29 if leap else 28):
+53|            return False
+54|    return True
+55|
+56|
+57|def _collect_date_candidates(text):
+58|    out = []
+59|    for m in re.finditer(r"(?<!\d)(\d{1,2})[/\-\.](\d{1,2})[/\-\.](\d{2,4})(?!\d)", text):
+60|        d, mo, y = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
+61|        y = _norm_year(y)
+62|        if _valid_date(y, mo, d):
+63|            out.append((m.start(), y, mo, d))
+64|    for m in re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)(\d{1,2})[\s\-]+([A-Za-z]{3,9})[\s\-]+(\d{2,4})(?!\w)", text):
+65|        d = int(m.group(1))
+66|        mon = m.group(2).lower()
+67|        mon = "sept" if mon.startswith("sept") else mon[:3]
+68|        y = int(m.group(3))
+69|        mo = MONTHS.get(mon)
+70|        if mo is None:
+71|            continue
+72|        y = _norm_year(y)
+73|        if _valid_date(y, mo, d):
+74|            out.append((m.start(), y, mo, d))
+75|    for m in re.finditer(r"(?<!\d)(20\d{2})[/\-\.](\d{1,2})[/\-\.](\d{1,2})(?!\d)", text):
+76|        y, mo, d = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
+77|        if _valid_date(y, mo, d):
+78|            out.append((m.start(), y, mo, d))
+79|    return out
+80|
+81|
+82|def _extract_date_one(text):
+83|    cands = _collect_date_candidates(text)
+84|    if not cands:
+85|        return None
+86|    for pos, y, mo, d in cands:
+87|        cy = _correct_year(y)
+88|        if cy is None:
+89|            continue
+90|        return (cy, mo, d)
+91|    return None
+92|
+93|
+94|def extract_date(text):
+95|    variants = text.split("==VARIANT==")
+96|    results = []
+97|    for v in variants:
+98|        r = _extract_date_one(v)
+99|        if r is not None:
+100|            results.append(r)
+101|    if not results:
+102|        return None
+103|    counter = Counter(results)
+104|    (y, mo, d), _ = counter.most_common(1)[0]
+105|    return f"{y:04d}-{mo:02d}-{d:02d}"
+106|
+107|
+108|# ----------------- Total parsing -----------------
+109|
+110|NUMBER_RE = re.compile(
+111|    r"(?<![\d.])(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+(?:\.\d{1,2})?|\d+\.\d{2})(?![\d])"
+112|)
+113|
+114|EXCLUDE_PATTERNS = [
+115|    r"\bSUB[\s\-]?TOTAL\b",
+116|    r"\bSUBTOTAL\b",
+117|    r"\bTAX\b",
+118|    r"\bGST\b",
+119|    r"\bSST\b",
+120|    r"\bDISCOUNT\b",
+121|    r"\bCHANGE\b",
+122|    r"\bCASH\b",
+123|    r"\bTENDERED?\b",
+124|    r"\bPAID\b",
+125|    r"\bPAYMENT\b",
+126|    r"\bSAVINGS?\b",
+127|    r"\bROUNDING\b",
+128|    r"\bROUND\s*A\w{0,4}\b",
+129|    r"\bSERV(?:ICE)?\s*(?:CHG|CHARGE|TAX)\b",
+130|    r"\bSVR\s+TAX\b",
+131|    r"\bGROSS\s+AMT\b",
+132|    r"\bGROSS\s+AMOUNT\b",
+133|    r"\bITEM\s+COUNT\b",
+134|    r"\bTOT\w*\s+QTY\b",
+135|    r"\bTOT\w*\s+QUANTITY\b",
+136|    r"\bTOT\w*\s+ITEMS?\b",
+137|    r"\bQTY\b",
+138|    r"\bQUANTITY\b",
+139|    r"\bCARD\b",
+140|    r"\bVISA\b",
+141|    r"\bMASTER\s*CARD\b",
+142|    r"\bPOINT\b",
+143|    r"\bBALANCE\b",
+144|    r"\bU\s*(?:NIT)?\s*PRICE\b",
+145|    r"\bU\.PRICE\b",
+146|    r"\bS/PRICE\b",
+147|]
+148|EXCLUDE_RE = re.compile("|".join(EXCLUDE_PATTERNS), re.IGNORECASE)
+149|
+150|
+151|def _normalize_for_exclusion(line):
+152|    s = re.sub(r"\([^)]*\)", " ", line)
+153|    s = re.sub(
+154|        r"(?i)\b(?:incl(?:uded|usive|uding)?|inc)\.?\s*(?:of\s+)?(?:GST|SST|TAX)\b",
+155|        " ",
+156|        s,
+157|    )
+158|    return s
+159|
+160|
+161|def _is_line_excluded(line):
+162|    s = _normalize_for_exclusion(line)
+163|    return bool(EXCLUDE_RE.search(s))
+164|
+165|
+166|SECTION_START_RE = re.compile(
+167|    r"(?i)\bGST\s*SUMMARY\b|\bGSTSUMMARY\b|\bTAX\s+CODE\b|\bGST\s+SUMMER\b"
+168|)
+169|
+170|
+171|def _mark_excluded(lines):
+172|    excluded = [False] * len(lines)
+173|    in_summary = False
+174|    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+175|        if SECTION_START_RE.search(line):
+176|            in_summary = True
+177|        if in_summary:
+178|            excluded[i] = True
+179|            continue
+180|        if _is_line_excluded(line):
+181|            excluded[i] = True

+183|
+184|
+185|def _extract_last_number(line):
+186|    nums = NUMBER_RE.findall(line)
+187|    if not nums:

+189|    val = nums[-1].replace(",", "")

+194|
+195|
+196|PRIORITY_KEYWORDS = [
+197|    [r"\bGRAND\s+TOT\w*"],
+198|    [r"\bTOT\w*\s*:?\s*RM\b"],
+199|    [r"\bTOT\w*\s+AMOUNT\b", r"\bTOT\w*\s+AMT\b", r"\bTOT\w*\s*AMOUN\b"],
+200|    [
+201|        r"\bNETT?\s+TOT\w*",
+202|        r"\bNET\s+AMT\b",
+203|        r"\bNET\s+AMOUNT\b",
+204|        r"\bNET\s+AMOUN\b",
+205|        r"\bTOT\w*\s+DUE\b",
+206|        r"\bAMOUNT\s+DUE\b",
+207|        r"\bAMT\s+DUE\b",
+208|        r"\bBALANCE\s+DUE\b",
+209|        r"\bROUNDED\s+TOT\w*",
+210|        r"\bFINAL\s+TOT\w*",
+211|        r"\bAMT\s+PAYABLE\b",
+212|        r"\bTOT\w*",
+213|        r"\bAMOUNT\b",
+214|        r"\bAMT\b",
+215|    ],
+216|]
+217|
+218|
+219|def _extract_total_one(text):
+220|    text = normalize_text(text)
+221|    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
+222|    if not lines:
+223|        return None, None
+224|    excluded = _mark_excluded(lines)
+225|    for tier_idx, tier in enumerate(PRIORITY_KEYWORDS):
+226|        pat = re.compile("|".join(tier), re.IGNORECASE)
+227|        best = None
+228|        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+229|            if excluded[i]:
+230|                continue
+231|            if not pat.search(line):
+232|                continue
+233|            val = _extract_last_number(line)
+234|            if val is None and i + 1 < len(lines) and not excluded[i + 1]:
+235|                val = _extract_last_number(lines[i + 1])
+236|            if val is not None:
+237|                best = (i, val)
+238|        if best is not None:
+239|            return tier_idx, best[1]
+240|    return None, None
+241|
+242|
+243|def extract_total(text):
+244|    variants = text.split("==VARIANT==")
+245|    results = []  # list of (tier, value, variant_idx)
+246|    for idx, v in enumerate(variants):
+247|        tier, val = _extract_total_one(v)
+248|        if val is not None:
+249|            results.append((tier, val, idx))
+250|    if not results:
+251|        return None
+252|    # Pick highest priority tier (lowest index)
+253|    best_tier = min(r[0] for r in results)
+254|    tier_results = [r for r in results if r[0] == best_tier]
+255|    # Majority vote within tier
+256|    vals = [r[1] for r in tier_results]
+257|    counter = Counter(vals)
+258|    most_common = counter.most_common()
+259|    top_count = most_common[0][1]
+260|    tied = [v for v, c in most_common if c == top_count]
+261|    if len(tied) == 1:
+262|        chosen = tied[0]
+263|    else:
+264|        # Tie-break: pick the one from the earliest variant.
+265|        for r in tier_results:
+266|            if r[1] in tied:
+267|                chosen = r[1]
+268|                break
+269|    return f"{chosen:.2f}"

+271|
+272|if __name__ == "__main__":
+273|    for p in sorted(Path("/app/workspace/ocr_full").glob("*.txt")):
